scope: Exact support/copy proof and independent floating residual audit of two NEW algorithm-unused weighted Gram operator examples. No LP/Schur solve, no old mechanics inverse/proof/example repeated.
exact_structure_theorem: No row touches two local blocks, so every off-diagonal local Gram block is structurally zero for arbitrary diagonal weights. Positive w,d imply SPD; the standard block factorization and Schur minimization identities follow algebraically. Numerical factors only checked for the saved example weights.
finite_precision_limit: Residual audit is not a directed-rounding certificate, uniform conditioning guarantee or proof for future changing weights.1e-11 is algebra-only; unchanged original1e-7 and physical gates are not replaced.
